title: Provisional measurement review
notice: These are newly derived, unvalidated educational observations. The source supplies no printed answer key for this exercise. They are unscored and require qualified ECG educator review.

fields.basis: Visually checked ventricular landmarks on original PDF 516
fields.reason: Successive ventricular peak spacings: 112 px, 106 px, 109 px, 106 px, 113 px, 111 px. Descriptive judgment from visible spacing, not a validated diagnostic threshold.

fields.basis: Course-standard 25 mm/s assumption; 150 independently detected small-square intervals across 737 pixels
fields.reason: Mean R–R estimate 67.3 bpm; six-second count estimate 70 bpm. All seconds/bpm depend on course-standard 25 mm/s. Count estimate assumes 150 small squares = 6 seconds; endpoint phase and partial complexes affect it. On irregular strips the count estimate is not a stable instantaneous rate. Mean RR describes only intervals between observed peaks.

fields.value: Candidate P-wave observation: Small pre-QRS positive candidates repeat before six complete cycles after the clipped first complex. They are only a few pixels high, with other minor baseline undulations also present. The immediate pre-QRS candidate is separate from the larger post-QRS hump in the measured cycles. This supports repeated timing but leaves weak-wave identity provisional.
fields.basis: Original PDF page 516; independently reconciled selected-complex observation
fields.reason: Provisional deflection description, not validated atrial identity or a diagnosis. Describes visible morphology/association only, not established P identity, atrial origin or conduction. Are the immediate pre-QRS low bumps true P waves rather than baseline texture, and where is their onset relative to the other low-amplitude interbeat bumps? This describes only the selected complexes or restricted subset. It does not establish a whole-strip event census, ventricular sequence completeness, atrial identity, or conduction relationship. Qualified ECG educator review is outstanding.

fields.basis: Original PDF page 516; independently reconciled endpoint bands and horizontal grid; assumes course 25 mm/s (0.04 s per small square), not a verified per-strip speed
fields.reason: Small rapid biphasic complexes have a reproducible negative terminal limb and subsequent slower recovery. Assumes course 25 mm/s and correct component identity/boundaries. Envelopes describe measurement uncertainty, not actual duration variability. Are the immediate pre-QRS low bumps true P waves rather than baseline texture, and where is their onset relative to the other low-amplitude interbeat bumps? This describes only the selected complexes or restricted subset. It does not establish a whole-strip event census, ventricular sequence completeness, atrial identity, or conduction relationship. This envelope includes reader and endpoint uncertainty; it is not a confidence interval, normal/abnormal classification, or proof of beat-to-beat physiological variation. Qualified ECG educator review is outstanding.

fields.value: Low-amplitude positive-negative complexes on a relatively stable baseline; negative troughs used for timing. No atrial or conduction conclusion assigned.
fields.basis: New provisional descriptive review, not a publisher answer or definitive rhythm diagnosis
fields.reason: Qualified ECG educator review has not occurred. Visible-deflection observations are supplied without validated P-wave identity. QRS has an unvalidated conditional estimate; numeric PR remains withheld.

limitations: Wave observations and conditional endpoint envelopes remain provisional and unscored. QT/QTc, calibrated amplitudes and clinical diagnosis are not established. Selected-complex widths do not establish sequence certainty.

pr unresolved: Author weak-candidate PR remains exploratory. Similar small interbeat excursions elsewhere on the trace prevent secure selection of one atrial onset; repeated temporal proximity alone is insufficient.
Independently measured span is 737 px, not 738. Timing calculation uses its measured 150-square span; tick endpoints and grid edges differ slightly due to raster positioning.
Excluded x700 and817 detector proposals: baseline/edge changes, not QRS.

P-wave text is a provisional description, not validated atrial identity. PR remains unresolved with no numerical answer. QRS has an unvalidated conditional endpoint envelope for selected complexes. Validated electrical boundaries and qualified educator adjudication remain outstanding.
Calibration assumes the course’s 25 mm/s convention, not speed metadata printed on each strip. Peak uncertainty is approximately ±2 source pixels, excluding errors in identifying the waveform.
